channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Swap executed? Track its route to Ethereum finality
item.description: A Layer 2 token swap becomes final when its batch is verified and executed on Ethereum, then the Ethereum settlement block reaches finality. Learn what status marks that stage.

item.title: Why did my token approval confirm but not my restaking deposit?
item.description: Token approval confirmed but restaking deposit missing? Approval grants spending permission; a separate deposit transaction must succeed to record your stETH.

item.title: When a Solana Creator Can Freeze Your Tokens
item.description: Can a token creator freeze your tokens? On Solana, yes, if they still control the freeze authority, which can lock an individual token account until thawed.

item.title: US secures authority over $1.2B in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says it has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance, while efforts to freeze other funds continue.

item.title: Canonical Bridged Tokens Depend on the Route
item.description: A canonical bridged token is the network-recognized representation of an asset on a specific bridge route. Learn how to identify its origin and mapping.

item.title: A Frozen Token Balance: Three Causes, Three Remedies
item.description: Why is my token balance frozen? An issuer freeze, platform hold or transfer error may be responsible; identify the restriction before choosing a remedy.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2B in Binance hack crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, within $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2B in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority over more than $1.2 billion of Binance’s stolen crypto, part of $2.7 billion frozen as recovery efforts continue.

item.title: US authorizes seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says U.S. efforts froze $2.7 billion after Binance’s $6 billion theft, with court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion.

item.title: DOJ gets authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department won court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion theft, part of $2.7 billion frozen.

item.title: US gets court authority to seize $1.2B in Binance theft
item.description: US authorities obtained court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance, part of a wider effort to recover funds.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2B in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance as authorities track funds still being laundered.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2bn from Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from the $6 billion Binance hack, as recovery efforts continue.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added Monad as a settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers on Nov. 10, expanding the networks available for stablecoin obligations.

item.title: PNC pilots Coinbase-powered USDC payments for business clients
item.description: PNC is piloting incoming USDC payments for eligible corporate and institutional clients, with Coinbase converting the tokens into dollars deposited at the bank.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers as annualized settlement volume reached $25 billion.

item.title: Payward and clients buy undisclosed amount of AAVE
item.description: Payward and its clients bought an undisclosed amount of AAVE on the secondary market, extending Kraken parent’s asset-management push into decentralized finance.

item.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials and tokens for all users
item.description: Chainalysis says an attacker exposed names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users, prompting account resets and service shutdowns.

item.title: Zcash Activates NU7, Cutting Target Block Time to 25 Seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block intervals to 25 seconds and expanding shielded payment capacity while routing fees to future mining rewards.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34B hack
item.description: Binance says a fake recruitment process helped attackers breach its wallet systems and steal $6.34 billion, prompting the exchange to replenish user assets.
